review.summary: The race is fixed by awaiting the token refresh before the retry. One edge case is left: a second 401 during the refresh.

findings.title: A second 401 during the refresh retries forever
findings.body: If the refresh call itself answers 401, `retry()` runs again with the same expired token. Stop after one refresh attempt.
